name: Satou Himeko
source: One of the special Ghosts who could not pass on, a high school student from the northern part of Japan who committed suicide in 2029. Her personality is frivolous and she uses gender-neutral language. Unlike the other Ghosts, she is the only one who is able to retain her original appearance.
